narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Old Site, Made Clear"**

The client wanted the structure they already knew (the current alhidaya.qa: a hero, About, What we do, Our clients, a quote form, a four-column footer) without it feeling like the same site. Shown five themes, they chose a mix, Theme 6 (plan D132): Theme 2's header and services cards, Theme 4's straight-lined hero and quote card, Theme 5's About and footer. It is a **Persuade** page on soft white, never a pure white (the client's words): deep blue leads every action, the logo's leaf green is the accent, photographs carry the care, and motion arrives as you read: slides wipe in, headings' words rise from behind their line, blocks rise as they scroll in, the clients' logos run in two rows.

Density stays low: one idea per section, the old site's order, generous section gaps; bands of mist and pale green mark What we do and the quote. The admin panel is a separate **Operate** surface and keeps its own look entirely (the user: "no changes needed in the admin panel or its designs").
keyCharacteristics: Soft white page (`page`), cards a touch lighter (`card`), mist and pale-leaf bands.
Deep blue for the main button, links and the highlighted phrase in a heading; leaf green for small marks (checks, the WhatsApp chip, the mark under a heading).
Buttons with 12 px corners; the header's links in a floating round pill.
One family, Inter Tight, semibold for headings and titles, regular for reading.
Automatic motion is limited to Home’s hero/services, Contact’s typewriter and the clients’ rows, with their recorded stop conditions and reduced-motion paths.

rules.name: The Never-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: On the public site, white is soft white: the page is `page`, a raised surface `card`. The user’s Contact exception (D145) sets its opening and form controls to pure `ground` white; other surfaces retain the existing palette.

rules.name: The Blue-Leads Rule
rules.body: One main action per view, deep blue with white words; green never carries an action on the site, only a mark.

rules.name: The White-Only-On-Dark Rule
rules.body: White text sits only on deep blue, navy or error red; sky and leaf carry navy. tests/contract/tokens.test.ts holds every pairing to 4.5:1, the soft whites included.

rules.name: The Logo-Only Rule
rules.body: No colour outside the tokens (D35), light theme only (D28); Tailwind's palette is removed so nothing else compiles.

rules.name: The Phrase-In-Blue Rule
rules.body: A heading may set one phrase in deep blue (the admin's highlighted words), in the same weight and flow as the rest; never a second phrase, never a background. On the D158 dimmed photo openings, the phrase takes a light tint of sky for contrast.

rules.name: The Transform-And-Opacity Rule
rules.body: Movement is transform and opacity; the slides' wipe is the one clip-path, on a single photo at a time.

rules.name: The Still-Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing else moves on its own (WCAG 2.2.2). The slides stop on deliberate keyboard focus; the clients' rows stop under the pointer, on focus and on a chosen logo (the user chose no pause button for them; recorded in D133). Contact’s explicitly requested typewriter is another exception (D147), paused offscreen/hidden and static for reduced motion.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion Path
rules.body: With reduced motion the engine never loads: no Lenis, no reveals, no word rising; the slides stay on the first slide, with static progress; the clients' rows stand still, their repeats gone, wrapped in rows; the header scrolls with the document; the menu's pill is simply on the new page; the phone menu appears and goes at once; an inner page's opening is simply there.

dos: Do take every colour, size, radius, shadow, duration and ease from the tokens.
Do keep the public site on soft white; raise a surface with `card`, never a pure white.
Do use one deep button per view, the line button beside it, the arrow only for an action that moves the visitor on.
Do give every interactive thing a 44 px target and keep the 3 px focus ring.
Do show only real facts and licensed or the client's own photographs (D7).

Do keep each public route within 174,080 bytes of gzip JavaScript at first paint; prefer CSS and server components (the slides' words and photos are drawn on the server; only their state is in the browser).
donts: Don't use a colour outside the logo's, a dark theme, or green for an action.
Don't round the hero, or bring back the running words, the statement, the highlights or the audience sections.
Don't add anything else that moves on its own.
Don't caption stock as Al Hidaya's staff, or invent statistics, testimonials or licences.
Don't add design controls to the admin (D12), or let its scoped green theme change the public site (D138).
